locations.note: The 1998 Czech original of NiBiRu tells the same story: Martin Holan starts on Charles Bridge in Prague.
The investigation continues through an apartment, archives and government offices in Prague.
Martin explores a wartime mine and the hidden laboratory beneath it in western Bohemia.
The French chapter: a hotel, the docks and his uncle's mansion.
Martin visits the invented town of Tecolut and explores Maya temples that are not tied to real sites.

routes.name: Martin Holan
routes.note: From Charles Bridge through Prague's archives to a Nazi mine in western Bohemia, his uncle's French mansion and the lost Maya temple of the gods.
